bundle.longDescription: Nubisianua is a small native window for your cloud AI agents on Windows and Linux, no browser required. One window holds your agents in tabs — Muse by default, plus ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Grok, Perplexity, Meta AI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Le Chat, Doubao, or any custom URL — each tab with its own sign-in, all running in the operating system's webview. It is a wrapper, not a local model.
bundle.shortDescription: A lightweight doorway to your cloud AI
